svg.title: Do the right numbers reach the manuscript?
svg.desc: The sample contrast is -31.6 g, with interval -74.3 to 11.0 g. Its saved source is linked to results text, the abstract, and caption, then checked in the final document.
svg.text: The agent records the source and where it is used
Same contrast, sample, units, interval, and rounding
When the result changes, review every linked use
